scope: Real five-step CPU runs only; no A100 outcomes

wrong_seed: Seed, oracle, batch, or update does not match the prospective configuration.
wrong_instance_hash: Frozen instance A_sha256 differs from the prospective data.
wrong_schedule: schedule alpha differs from the prospectively required or independently recomputed value.
wrong_trajectory_mean: summary full-trajectory mean true_smoothed_gap differs from the prospectively required or independently recomputed value.
terminal_inclusion: Terminal/pre-update trajectory inclusion flags are incorrect.
